title: India's organ-transplant/donation cluster
summary: 16th Indian Organ Donation Day (Aug 3) — moved from Nov 27 (in 2023); marks India's 1st heart transplant (1994)...

items: 16th Indian Organ Donation Day (Aug 3) — moved from Nov 27 (in 2023); marks India's 1st heart transplant (1994)

NOTTO Annual Report 2025-26: India performed record 20,138 organ transplants in 2025 — **ranks 3rd globally** (behind US, China); Tamil Nadu tops deceased-donor list (266) and "Best State" for organ donation, also #1 in heart/lung transplants nationally
India crosses **5 lakh** Aadhaar-verified organ donation pledges (in 3 yrs since 2023 portal launch); Min. Anupriya Patel launched year-long 'Jug Jug Jiyo' campaign
**e-Pratyaropan Portal** launched by NOTTO (under MoHFW) — unified digital ecosystem for organ donation/transplant
Indian Railways — 1st live donor heart transported by train (Surat→Ahmedabad via Vande Bharat Express, dedicated Green Corridor)

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — India ranks 3rd globally in organ transplants (20,138 in 2025).
